key_points: Shanti’s parents seemed busier planning their summer vacation.
“Are we doing something different this year?”, she asked.
“Maybe we could go to more places rather than staying in one place?
I really want to see more of our country now that I am growing up.” Appa (father) and Amma (mother) smiled, “Shanti, your wish might just come true.
A trip to a few different places starting from the southernmost tip of India!”.
